colors.name: deep-space
colors.role: page ground — the night the aurora drifts over; deepens toward #06080f behind text via scrims

colors.name: violet
colors.role: primary accent — brand color, focus ring, mesh blob, CTA fill (12.3:1 on glass body)

colors.name: fuchsia
colors.role: mesh blob, char-split second line, pin-progress — accents only, never long body text (6.0:1)

colors.name: cyan
colors.role: mesh blob, hairline tint, kicker on dark — the cool register (10.4:1 on glass body)

colors.name: emerald
colors.role: mesh blob, success marker, 'live' dot (12.6:1 on glass body)

colors.name: frost
colors.role: primary text — the reading voice, ~15.4:1 on deep-space and ≥10:1 on every glass body

colors.name: frost-dim
colors.role: secondary text — captions, Korean glosses, labels (frost at ~64% luminance, 8.0:1 on glass body)

colors.name: glass-fill
colors.role: glass card body at 46% alpha over the mesh, under blur(18px) saturate(160%) — the frost text floor

colors.name: hairline
colors.role: decorative ONLY (≈1.8:1): card borders, dividers, track strokes — derived as frost #f1f3fb at 16% alpha over deep-space

fonts.role: display — mast, headlines, kickers, the launch voice; set on var(--font-display)
body/UI — paragraph copy, labels, CTAs, chrome; set on var(--font-body)
every Hangul glyph — Korean never falls through to a Latin sans; set on var(--font-kr)

texture: One living sky, layered: a full-bleed morphing mesh of five oversized radial-gradient blobs (violet, fuchsia, cyan, emerald, and a violet-fuchsia blend) drifting on mutually-prime cycles (24s, 31s, 19s, 17s) so the field never visibly loops; a static deep-space wash underneath as the no-animation and reduced-motion floor; a fine SVG feTurbulence grain over everything at 3.5% opacity to kill the banding that mesh gradients show on dark panels; behind the pinned feature stack, a faint conic aurora sweep turns once a cycle. Glass cards are backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(160%) over that mesh, with hairline frost borders and a 1px top tint that borrows the accent. Deep-space scrims under every text region guarantee AA wherever a bright blob drifts behind copy.

motion.name: ease-out-settle
motion.value: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) — reveals and pin assemble: fast in, long settle

motion.name: ease-in-out-morph
motion.value: cubic-bezier(0.45, 0, 0.55, 1) — the mesh breathes between poses

motion.name: reveal
motion.value: 650ms ease-out-settle, translateY(16px)→0 + opacity 0→1, 70ms stagger per observer batch

motion.name: char-split
motion.value: headline glyphs translateY(110%)→0 on 44ms stagger, mask clip per line; aria-hidden animated spans over an aria-label

motion.name: mesh morph
motion.value: violet/fuchsia/cyan/emerald blobs translate+scale on 24s/31s/19s/17s ease-in-out alternate — no shared divisor, no loop

motion.name: pin assemble
motion.value: --aurora-pin 0→1 lerp-smoothed scroll progress; cards translateY/scale/opacity ride its piecewise easing

motion.name: tilt lerp
motion.value: 0.12 per 60fps-normalized frame — cards follow the cursor like held glass, not a cursor

motion.name: tilt range
motion.value: rotateX/Y capped ±7deg, translateZ up to 60px; perspective 900px

motion.name: pin progress
motion.value: 2px violet→fuchsia gradient bar, scaleX(0→1) on scroll, the section's own scrubbed meter
